people.imagined: Noon in the desert at the well. He measures the water in his cupped hand by the mouthful, squinting under a white hood, and has just noticed a rider.
people.subject: The moment: noon at a stone well-head in the white desert; the captain of the guard lets a thin thread of water fall from his cupped palm, counting it by the mouthful, and squints hard at the viewer, having just spotted a rider. Face: a hard, wind-cut face of fifty the colour of tanned saddle-leather; eyes narrowed to two dark slits, the squint carved into deep crow's-feet that run to the temples; a short broken nose; a thick grey-flecked moustache over a thin callous mouth; a salt-white crust at the corners of the lips; a sunburnt peeling scar across the forehead. Hair: iron-grey, cropped almost to the scalp, half hidden by a pale hood of frost-white gauze. Body: broad, square and heavy-shouldered, hardened by sun; stands with his weight on his heels and arms loose. Clothing: three layers of flowing white silk with collars edged in ice blue, the outer one a pale blue gauze over-robe of an elder that drifts at the hem with fine desert dust; wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with silver snowflakes; a shimmering frost-silk sash hung with a white jade pendant; a hooded white cloak of spirit-woven gauze thrown back from the head. Hands and objects: the left hand cupped, water trickling between the fingers in a bright thread; the right resting on the hilt of a plain straight sword with a white jade pommel. Power: the falling water glints with a cold blue sheen, and a thin silver frost-mist clings to his sword hand in the heat, as if the desert air near him were cooler. Background: white sand, a round stone well-head with rope and bucket, one camel's long neck blurred, a wavering horizon dissolving into pale mist. Light: hard white noon softened by a silvery rim light along his shoulder, black shadow under the brow, the water a bright glint. Expression: callous, watchful and loyal; no smile, a man who has buried many raiders and counts water as treasure.

people.imagined: Night in the burial glacier. She is speaking to the standing dead in a whisper so low that they seem to lean in; her cuffs are black from lamp soot.
people.subject: The moment: night inside the burial glacier; she lifts a small brass lamp beside a row of standing dead sealed in ice, speaking in a whisper so low that they seem to lean in, and turns her face softly to the viewer, lips barely parted. Face: a small, old, pale, gentle face of sixty; deep fine wrinkles like cracks in porcelain; very large calm dark eyes; thin soft mouth; a straight small nose; frost crystals on her lashes and on a few wisps at her temples. Hair: white, parted in the middle and drawn into a low coil, held by a long white-jade pin shaped like a thin icicle. Body: slight, narrow and a little bent, as if leaning to listen. Clothing: an inner robe of white silk with a crossed collar, a second collar of frost-pale gauze, and over them an elder's over-robe of pale blue gauze that drifts like mist; wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with silver snowflakes and frost ferns, both cuffs smudged dark with lamp soot, plain against the silver; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; a shawl of white fur over the shoulders. Hands and objects: a small brass lamp with a pinpoint flame held at breast height in both hands, soot on the thumbs. Power: a deep, quiet cold gathers round her like a pale blue halo of breath, fine ice motes turning slowly in the air and settling on the shoulders of the sealed dead behind her. Background: blurred pale figures frozen upright in blue ice, facing away to the south, in a row that recedes into dark mist. Light: spirit-light of cold blue from the ice around her, the lamp's warm point lighting her chin from below, a faint silver rim along her hair. Expression: serene and devout, the withdrawn stillness of someone who is entirely at ease among friends.

people.imagined: Late at night at his desk, he has just found a bill in his own hand counted twice, and licks his thumb to check it again.
people.subject: The moment: late at night at his desk, the treasurer has found a bill counted twice in his own hand; he licks a thumb to check the sum again, holds a blank slip up to the lamp and looks sharply over its edge at the viewer. Face: a narrow, grey-yellow face of fifty-five with sunken cheeks; small sharp eyes set close together; a long thin nose; a pinched mouth drawn tight like a purse-string, the lips moving faintly as if tasting the total. Hair: thin grey hair scraped back flat into a tight knot, held by a plain bone pin. Body: thin, stooped and narrow in the chest, shoulders hunched over the desk. Clothing: layered robes of spotless white silk, exactly fitted, with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and an elder's pale blue gauze over-robe lying neat and still on his shoulders; the cuffs embroidered with small silver snowflakes in perfectly even rows; a frost-silk sash knotted tight, hung with a white jade pendant and a small bone abacus on a cord. Hands and objects: the blank slip of paper held to the lamp between two thumbs and fingertips stained black with ink, shown plainly in the foreground; a brush in a stand and a stone ink-slab on the desk before him. Power: a thin cold line of silver-blue qi runs through the fingers that count, and faint metallic glints flicker on the abacus beads as they tick. Background: a dark room, bundles of paper slips tied with cord on a shelf behind drifting mist, a brass lamp, a cold stove. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left against deep blue dark, catching the sharp bones of his face, a pale moonlit rim on his shoulder. Expression: a tight, suspicious, calculating stare, the brows pulled in and the mouth working silently, a man who trusts no figure, least of all his own.

people.imagined: On the harbour at dawn, laughing at something a boatman said, his flattened nose giving the laugh a wet, loud tone that carries across the water.
people.subject: The moment: on the harbour at dawn he laughs at something a boatman said, and the flattened nose gives the laugh a wet, loud tone that carries across the water; he stands on the bow of a skiff, one hand on the mast, head thrown back, then looks down at the viewer with a bright cruel eye. Face: a heavy, square, red-brown face of fifty-five; a nose flattened flat against the face from an old blow; a wide laughing mouth showing a gap; small hard blue eyes; a grey-stubbled jaw; deep laugh lines. Hair: grizzled grey-black, tied back in a short tail with a pale blue silk cord and a silver pin. Body: huge-chested, short-necked and very strong, legs apart on the boards. Clothing: flowing white silk robes cut shorter for the boat, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, an elder's pale blue gauze over-robe knotted back at the hip and snapping in the sea wind; wide sleeves with silver wave and snowflake embroidery at the cuffs, coast-blue lining flashing at the wrist; a shimmering frost-silk sash bright with salt, hung with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: one scarred hand on a wet mast; the other holds a long dark boat-hook with a silver-bright point, a straight sword in a white scabbard at his hip. Power: a swirl of pale blue sea-mist and flying droplets coils round him, rising in a loose ring as he laughs, the water answering his strength. Background: a grey harbour, other skiffs with brown sails, shelves of ice at the edge, pale spirit-mist on the water. Light: cold bright dawn with a silver rim light on his jaw and shoulders, spray glittering. Expression: loud and gregarious, a warlike delight in the weather, though the laugh never quite reaches the eyes.

people.imagined: Deep under the seat, she places her palm on a cold node and hums a single note until it answers; her left sleeve is pinned back.
people.subject: The moment: deep under the seat, in a tunnel of the Jade Vessel Array, she places her bare left palm on a cold blue node and hums a single note until the stone answers; her left sleeve is pinned back; her eyes slide to the viewer. Face: a narrow, careful, pale face of thirty-eight; dark eyes that give nothing; thin level brows; a small straight nose; a slightly pursed mouth; a faint line between the brows; a trace of white chalk on one cheek. Hair: black, in one tight braid coiled at the nape and pinned with a silver hairpin shaped like a snowflake. Body: slim, composed and very still, leaning a little toward the node. Clothing: three layers of flowing white silk with collars edged in ice blue, a translucent frost-pale gauze outer robe, the left wide sleeve pinned back above the elbow by a plain silver pin to bare the forearm; silver snowflakes and frost ferns embroidered at the right cuff; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant, a dusting of chalk on its tassel. Hands and objects: the bare left hand flat on a round pale blue carved stone that glows faintly; a stub of white chalk in her right; a small lamp at her foot. Power: pale blue light climbs her bare arm in fine branching lines like frost on glass, and a hum of cool silver motes drifts up from the stone. Background: a low stone tunnel with a ring of faint blue lights fading into mist and dark; a footprint brushed from the dust. Light: cold blue spirit-light rising from the stone beneath her hand, a soft silver rim on her hair. Expression: careful, patient and quietly hiding something.

people.imagined: On the glacier path, she nods politely to empty air as the standing dead go by, frost forming on her pale lashes.
people.subject: The moment: on the glacier path, she nods politely to empty air as the standing dead go by, frost forming on her pale lashes; she stops and looks up at the viewer. Face: a pale, delicate face of thirty-two; large grey eyes with long lashes furred with frost; a small, soft mouth; high cheekbones; a calm brow; a faint pink at the tip of the nose; her breath leaves her lips as a thin white plume, and a tiny crust of frost has formed on one eyebrow. Hair: long and black, loose down the back, held at the crown by a small white jade pin and tied at the nape with a pale blue ribbon. Body: slender and upright, hands before her, the bow just finished. Clothing: soft white silk with a high crossed inner collar and two more collars of frost-pale gauze edged in ice blue; wide sleeves falling in long folds, with silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; a light shawl of white gauze over the shoulders. Hands and objects: both hands folded in front of her, holding a small white lamp with a thin flame. Power: faint pale blue motes of cold gather around her lamp-hand and drift upward like snow falling the wrong way. Background: blue ice walls and the faint shapes of standing figures sealed in ice, facing south, lost in mist. Light: soft moonlit blue from the upper left, a warm point from the lamp, a thin silver rim light on her hair. Expression: a calm, humble face with a devout ease about it, entirely unafraid among the dead and polite to all of them.

people.imagined: In the hall she touches the jade pin in her sleek braids, furious again, her eyes on a frost-coast disciple across the room.
people.subject: The moment: in the hall she touches the jade pin in her sleek braids, furious again, her eyes fixed on a frost-coast disciple across the room; she raises two fingers to the pin and glares at the viewer, chin high. Face: a sharp, handsome, hard face of thirty-six; slanted dark eyes; thin, perfectly arched brows; a thin red-pink mouth set in contempt; a small sharp nose; flawless pale skin with high colour at the cheekbones. Hair: glossy black, plaited into two sleek braids coiled high and fixed with a long jade hairpin, a few pale blue silk threads woven into the plait. Body: tall, rigid and narrow-shouldered, held like a blade. Clothing: layered white silk, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, perfectly pressed, with an outer robe of translucent frost-pale gauze whose long sleeves fall in exact straight folds; silver snowflakes and frost ferns embroidered at the cuffs in cold precision; a shimmering frost-silk sash hung with a white jade pendant and silver tassels. Hands and objects: two fingers on the jade pin at her temple; a white-hilted sword with a pale scabbard at her left hip; fine nails. Power: a sharp thread of cold blue qi hums along the sword's scabbard and a few ice-white motes quiver in the air about her temple. Background: a pale hall of white pillars dissolving into mist, with the shapes of other disciples far behind. Light: cold moonlit light from the upper left, a glint on the jade and a crisp silver rim along her cheek. Expression: arrogant and cruel, the whole face closed to everyone except one person, whom it does not need to look at.

people.imagined: Practice hall, late. He swings the white-wrapped palms in the Snow Plum forms again; the wraps have bled through by evening.
people.subject: The moment: in the practice hall, late; he has just finished drilling the Snow Plum forms again, and he holds out both hands before him, palms up, wrapped in white strips stained rust-red through, then looks at the viewer. Face: a long, grim, dark-browed face of forty-two; deep-set black eyes; a tight jaw clenched; a short stubbled chin; a vertical furrow in the forehead; sweat at the temples; a small white scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot under a small silver crown-pin, a few loose strands stuck to his temples. Body: lean, upright and rigid with restraint; shoulders loose but the neck cords standing out. Clothing: flowing white silk sword-hall robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a translucent frost gauze over-robe, sleeves cut narrower for the blade; silver snowflakes and plum blossoms embroidered at the cuffs, the collar damp with sweat; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: both palms wrapped in white cloth strips stained rust-red at the centre, in the foreground; behind him a sword rack with a plain white-bladed sword and one empty peg. Power: petals of pale blue frost-light drift down around him like falling plum blossom, left over from the forms, and a faint silver sheen of qi lies on his shoulders. Background: a plain sword hall with a polished floor reflecting a window of dusk and drifting mist. Light: slanting evening light from the upper left turning to cool moonlight, with a silver rim on his jaw. Expression: silent and ambitious, a long unspoken grievance held behind the teeth, wrath kept under a tight, level mouth.

people.imagined: At the Beast Hall door a big white ice wolf leans on his hip; he is half asleep standing and takes the praise of the hall with a lazy grin.
people.subject: The moment: at the Beast Hall door a big white-maned ice wolf leans on his hip; he is half asleep standing, and takes the praise of the hall with a lazy grin as he looks at the viewer. Face: a handsome, relaxed face of forty; half-lidded easy eyes; a lopsided grin; a day's stubble; fine laugh lines; a faint pink at the nose. Hair: black, loose and a little unkempt to the shoulder, caught up at the crown by a silver pin, white wolf hairs drifting in it. Body: tall, loose-limbed and leaning, the left knee bent in an awkward way that clicks, his weight given over to the wolf. Clothing: flowing white silk riding robes, shorter in the skirt, three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a pale gauze over-robe with white wolf hair clinging in clear drifts; wide sleeves with silver snowflakes at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash hung with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: one hand buried in the thick ruff of an ice wolf whose mane rises to his ribs, its pale eyes half closed in pleasure, its coat brushed to silk; the other holds a small jade stirrup-cup; behind him in the doorway a younger rider with an owl feather by his ear carries a bucket. Power: where his hand rests, pale blue motes of frost shimmer along the wolf's ruff and drift in lazy spirals around them both. Background: a pale blue stone yard, the wolf's flank, a barred door in mist. Light: cold clear moonlight from the upper left with a soft silver rim on both man and beast. Expression: lazy and fickle, pleased to take the credit, with a relaxed gregarious grin.

people.imagined: By the rod-house stove, writing in her thunder log with soot freckled on her nose; a second book under her sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: by the rod-house stove, writing in her thunder log with soot freckled on her nose and a second book hidden under her sleeve; she looks up with a flat polite smile. Face: a small round face of thirty-two with soot freckles across the nose and cheeks; bright quick brown eyes; a small mouth; short brows; a dimple; a thin line of soot along her jaw where she has rubbed it. Hair: brown, in two buns on top, tied with pale blue silk ribbon and held with small silver pins. Body: small, neat, sitting straight, the open log on her knee and the hidden one tied with a red thread. Clothing: white silk robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a light frost gauze outer layer, the wide sleeves tied back with silk cords to keep them from the ink; silver snowflakes at the cuffs, scorched faintly at one hem; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant and a copper rod tucked into it. Hands and objects: a brush in her right hand, fingers inked; a book open on her knee; the corner of a second book under her sleeve; a mug of tea steaming on the stove top. Power: thin violet-blue threads of static crawl over the copper rod and jump to her sleeve in tiny sparks, mixed with cold silver motes of frost. Background: a small hut, a red stove glow, a row of copper rods on the wall each tipped blue-black with scorch, a rain-streaked window in drifting mist. Light: warm stove glow from the lower left, cool moonlight from the upper left, a flicker of spirit-light on the rods. Expression: cautious and content, a polite smile that gives away nothing about the second book.

people.imagined: In her warm hut at night with an injured sable on her lap, she smooths its fur; a crooked finger shows.
people.subject: The moment: in her warm hut at night with an injured sable on her lap, she smooths its fur and looks up gently at the viewer. Face: a quiet, long, fine face of thirty-eight; soft dark eyes; a gentle mouth; one little scar on the chin; a pink flush from the warmth. Hair: long black hair in two braids hanging forward over her shoulders with a few white sable hairs and straw dust caught in them, a white jade pin at the crown. Body: slim, patient and bent over her work, sleeves pushed up showing thin forearms with old bite-scars. Clothing: flowing white silk robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, the topmost a thick soft collar of white sable fur over frost gauze; wide sleeves with silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: her right hand strokes a pale cream-white sable with a bandaged hind foot, the little finger of that hand crooked from an old bite, plainly shown; a bowl of warm milk beside her; two other kits asleep in a basket by the stove. Power: a soft pale blue glow of cool qi rests in her palm, and tiny frost motes settle on the sable and melt into a warm, calming mist. Background: a warm hut with straw, a small lamp, a row of small cages, a jar of salve and a roll of clean bandage on the straw, a low roof hung with dried herbs and furs. Light: warm golden lamplight from the upper left against cool moonlit blue at the window, a soft rim light on her hair. Expression: a gentle, patient look, withdrawn from the world and completely absorbed in the small animal in her lap.

people.imagined: At the skiff's tiller in a rising storm, a pale scar across his chin white with salt, grinning because he would row it into the storm if asked.
people.subject: The moment: at the skiff's tiller in a rising storm, a pale scar across his chin white with salt; he grips the tiller in a spray-dashed skiff and grins at the viewer, braced against the wind. Face: a broad square face of forty; a salt-white scar across the chin, plain and bright; fearless light eyes; windburnt cheeks; wet black stubble; the scar shines whiter than his teeth. Hair: black, short, plastered with spray under a silver circlet pin. Body: shoulders as broad as a door, huge arms with sleeves pushed to the elbow, braced on wide-set legs. Clothing: short white silk robes soaked grey, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a flowing frost-gauze outer layer streaming back in the wind; silver wave and snowflake embroidery at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant swinging; a sealskin cloak flung back from the shoulders. Hands and objects: both hands on a tiller of black oak scored with notches, knuckles white; a coil of wet rope at his feet; a straight sword in a white scabbard lashed at his hip. Power: pale blue spray lifts in a ring around the skiff and curls toward his hands, the waves leaning to his will, a few ice motes glittering in the air. Background: a heaving grey sea and drifting ice, the brown reefed sail and the black bows of two other skiffs, a boy hauling a line, a lantern swinging on the mast, spirit-mist on the horizon. Light: cold storm light from the upper left with a hard white glint on the spray and a silver rim along his shoulder. Expression: brave and impatient, a loyal fierce grin, daring the weather to try him.

people.imagined: In the Desert Pavilion's courtyard, receiving a caravan factor and noticing again the way the seat's disciples listen to her accent.
people.subject: The moment: in the Desert Pavilion's courtyard, receiving a caravan factor and noticing again the way the seat's disciples listen to her accent; she bows politely toward the viewer with her sash sitting a little high at the waist, smiling humbly. Face: a round warm-brown face of thirty-five; large gentle dark eyes; a quick shy smile; a small gold stud in one nostril. Hair: black, parted and braided with a few bright harbour beads of green and red glass at the end, a small silver pin at the crown. Body: short, sturdy and upright, a young disciple behind her glancing over a shoulder and murmuring to another. Clothing: white silk robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a thin frost-gauze desert veil drifting at her neck; wide sleeves with silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash tied a little higher than the Pavilion way, the knot of pale blue silk tied twice, with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: hands folded in front of the sash, a small cloth purse and a small bronze bell on her wrist that tinkles when she bows; a camel kneels at the edge of the frame in a saddle-cloth of harbour stripes. Power: a faint cool silver-blue shimmer hangs in the warm air about her folded hands, like dew on the sand at dawn. Background: a sand-coloured courtyard, an awning throwing a sharp band of shade across her feet, camels blurred in warm haze and pale mist. Light: warm golden desert light from the upper left cooled by a silver moonlike rim on her cheek. Expression: a shy, humble smile that expects to be watched, trusting and quietly diligent in every small movement.

people.imagined: On the caravan road, upright as his banner pole, with the white banner furled and dust-free; he checks its hem and a dent on his thumb shows.
people.subject: The moment: on the caravan road, upright as his banner pole, with the white banner furled and dust-free; he checks its hem, then glances at the viewer. Face: a straight-nosed, correct, handsome face of forty-two; a thin neat moustache; narrow eyes with a hint of falseness; chin lifted. Hair: black, oiled, neatly knotted under a small silver crown-pin. Body: straight as a post, shoulders squared. Clothing: flowing white silk robes pressed and spotless, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, frost-pale gauze over-robe without a grain of sand; wide sleeves with silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; boots dusted pale to the ankle while the robe stays immaculate. Hands and objects: both hands on a pole with a polished brass cap, the cap worn bright by his thumb; the pole carries a furled plain white banner wrapped in oilcloth and tied with three neat knots; a straight sword in a white scabbard at his hip. Power: a clean cold glimmer of silver-blue qi runs the length of the pole and keeps the dust off the furled hem, motes of frost spinning at its tip. Background: sand and a dim caravan wagon with a bundled cloth, behind him a young guard with a split lip brushing dust from a different hem, all dissolving into pale desert mist. Light: bright desert light from the upper left softened by a silver rim on his shoulder and the banner's hem. Expression: stubborn and vain, a brave man who is mostly concerned that someone is watching how he stands.

people.imagined: Writing the coast's judgements, a calligrapher's reed-pen in his hand, a cup of tea going cold at his elbow; he decides by mood and does not know it.
people.subject: The moment: writing the coast's judgements in a quiet study, a calligrapher's reed-pen in his hand, a cup of tea gone cold at his elbow; he decides by mood and does not know it, and glances up at the viewer with a faint smile. Face: a long, composed, scholarly face of forty-eight; patient half-lidded eyes; a thin moustache and a wisp of chin beard; fine smooth skin; one corner of the mouth tightening as he decides. Hair: grey-black, in a neat topknot held by a dark wooden pin and a small silver crown. Body: thin, upright and deliberate. Clothing: flowing white silk scholar's robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a frost-pale gauze over-robe with long drifting sleeves, the right cuff darkened with ink; silver snowflakes and frost ferns embroidered at the hems; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a long brush in the right hand, fingers black with ink to the second knuckle; a single long clean curve of ink just begun on a blank sheet; a bamboo brush-rest with seven brushes sorted by size; a cup of tea with a skin on it. Power: a still pool of pale blue qi lies in the brush-water, and a few silvery motes of mist rise from the nib and fade as the stroke dries. Background: a quiet study, a screen of pale paper with no writing, a stack of blank sheets, mist at the window. Light: soft cold moonlight from the upper left, a gentle silver rim on his sleeve. Expression: patient and honest, with the faint look of a man who is sure his mood is a principle.

people.imagined: Copying a letter at night in the envoy's study, ink at the corner of her mouth, she lifts her eyes at a footstep.
people.subject: The moment: copying a letter at night in the envoy's study, ink at the corner of her mouth; she lifts her eyes at a footstep. Face: a sharp, pretty, ambitious face of thirty; bright watchful eyes; a small smile that comes too fast; a smudge of wet ink at the corner of the mouth. Hair: a very heavy black braid pinned over the left shoulder with a long silver hairpin that swings as she turns. Body: slim and quick. Clothing: layered white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a light frost-gauze over-robe, the narrow upper sleeves tied back with pale blue cords, silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; her sleeve slid over the paper she has been copying. Hands and objects: a brush in her hand; a sheet before her with no writing; a second finished copy half hidden under a blotter by her elbow. Power: a few cool silver motes of qi collect over the wet ink and a thin pale blue thread of light follows the brush tip. Background: a night study with a low lamp nearly out of oil, a half-open door behind her showing a dark corridor with a sliver of light and a pair of slippers just visible, drifting mist. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left against deep blue dark, a silver rim light on the braid. Expression: ambitious and faithless, a bright deceitful poise held a fraction too long as the footstep nears.

people.imagined: At the treasurer's table, reading a column of figures with a finger under each line, lips split and red from the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at the treasurer's table, reading a column of figures with a finger under each line, her lips split and red from the cold; she pushes the page a little away as if guarding a shameful number and looks up at the viewer. Face: a thin tired face of thirty-eight; lips cracked and split by the cold, red at the seams; small watchful eyes; wind-reddened cheeks; a thin plume of breath rising from her lips. Hair: brown, tied in a tight bun with a silver pin and a plain pale blue cord. Body: thin, narrow and hunched slightly. Clothing: white silk robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a frost-gauze over-robe, neat clerk's cuff-guards of white silk over the wide sleeves, silver snowflakes at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; a fur-lined glove half off. Hands and objects: one forefinger, bound in a small piece of cloth over a cracked knuckle, on a page of figures with no readable writing; a neat pile of green-bound ledgers and one set out of line. Power: a faint cold blue sheen clings to the cracked skin of her knuckles and fine frost motes hang above the page. Background: a dim counting room, stacks of paper, a brazier at her feet nearly out, a tall shelf of boxes casting a long shadow, pale mist. Light: dim moonlit light from the upper left, a faint red glow from the dying brazier, a thin silver rim on her cheek. Expression: a tight, guarded and watchful look, diligent on the surface, her loyalty visibly divided behind the eyes.

people.imagined: In the ringing hall she bursts into laughter, gap-toothed, as her master Khương Lưu Ly frowns in vain.
people.subject: The moment: in the ringing hall she bursts into laughter, gap-toothed, as her master frowns in vain at the far end; she is mid-motion, her ponytail flying, and her bright eyes catch the viewer. Face: a bright, freckled, fisher's-daughter face of twenty-two; a visible gap in the front teeth; sparkling dark eyes crinkled shut at the corners; apple cheeks flushed pink; dark winged brows. Hair: black, tied in a high ponytail with a pale blue silk ribbon, one end of which has jostled loose and flies, a small silver pin at the crown. Body: slim, quick and mid-motion. Clothing: flowing white silk sword robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a light frost-gauze outer layer swinging with her turn, sleeves a little narrower; silver snowflakes and waves embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: one hand on the hilt of a plain white sword at the hip, its white scabbard faintly chipped; the other half-raised mid-laugh. Power: a quick shimmer of pale blue water-light follows her raised hand and tiny droplets of spirit-light scatter into the air with the laugh. Background: a white-pillared hall that seems to ring with the echo, a stern woman in a pressed robe blurred at the far end with lips pressed together, a pair of older disciples glancing sideways, soft mist. Light: bright cool light from the upper left with a silver rim along her cheek and ponytail. Expression: fickle, brave and gregarious, with joy so open that the whole hall seems to join in.

people.imagined: In the coast quarter's tavern, a white robe worn over the coast's blue lining; the drawl is thick as stew; he is telling a story.
people.subject: The moment: in the coast quarter's tavern, telling a story with a thick drawl, a white robe worn open over the coast's blue lining; he raises one hand mid-gesture and grins at the viewer. Face: a broad, ruddy, quick-grinning face of forty-two; flashing dark eyes; a wide mobile mouth; short stubble. Hair: black, cropped short, a silver pin at the crown. Body: stocky, expansive and easy. Clothing: flowing white silk robes of an inner disciple worn open, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, the coast-blue silk lining flashing at both wrists and all along the open front, a frost-gauze over-robe slipping from one shoulder; silver wave and snowflake embroidery at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; sandals with salt rims. Hands and objects: a straight sword in a white scabbard at his hip; one hand raised with the palm out, broad and warm; a cup of wine in the other; the lamp over the table is a paper lantern painted with plain blue waves. Power: pale blue sea-mist curls from his rolling hand and mingles with the steam of a fish stew, motes of cool light drifting through the lamplit air. Background: a lamplit tavern, a table of coast disciples crowding round a clay pot of fish stew with steam rising, one laughing, a wine jug tipped by his elbow. Light: warm golden lamplight from the upper left with a cool silver rim light on his shoulder. Expression: a charming, gregarious smile that is quick to warmth and just as quick to turn faithless or wrathful.

people.imagined: In the burial glacier, he has just finished a niche with a chisel; the dust has whitened his eyebrows.
people.subject: The moment: in the burial glacier, he has just finished cutting a niche with a chisel; the dust has whitened his eyebrows, and he looks up at the viewer. Face: a stern, deeply lined face of fifty; eyebrows white with chisel dust; narrow, stubborn eyes; a heavy square jaw; a flat mouth. Hair: iron-grey, short, dusted white, a plain white jade pin at the crown. Body: broad-backed and sturdy; fine white dust lies on his shoulders like snow and on the back of his neck. Clothing: white silk robes of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a frost-pale gauze over-robe, the wide sleeves pushed up and tied back with pale blue cords, hems dusty with ice; silver snowflakes at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a short iron chisel and a wooden mallet whose head is worn to a dark polish; his square hands grey with grit in every crease. Power: a quiet cold gathers at the chisel's edge, and pale blue light seeps from the freshly cut ice around the niche as fine crystal dust rises and glitters. Background: a blue ice wall with half-cut niches, a tall narrow arch with a smooth floor and its twin beside it standing empty, a little longer and narrower, a drift of pale shavings on the floor, a hooded lantern on a hook, mist. Light: cold blue spirit-light from the ice on the upper left, a faint silver rim on his shoulders. Expression: stubborn and devout, reclusive, the face of a man who is cutting his own resting place and is content with the work.

people.imagined: At dawn at the founder's cold well with a bucket, her hem damp; a dried lily bulb pins her pale braid.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn at the founder's cold well with a bucket, her hem damp; a dried lily bulb pins her pale braid, and she looks up gently at the viewer. Face: a soft round oasis face of thirty-seven; warm brown skin; peaceful dark eyes; a gentle smile; freckles. Hair: pale brown, in a braid pinned up with a dried white lily bulb shaped like a small pearl and a silver pin. Body: sturdy, gentle and stooped to the well, sleeves tucked up to show round forearms with a rope scar. Clothing: white silk robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a light frost-gauze outer layer, the hem and lower sleeves dark and damp; silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; wet sandals on sandy stone. Hands and objects: both hands on a wet rope; a pot of ice lilies, small white cups on thin stems, at the foot of the well; a clay water jar beside the bucket. Power: faint pale blue vapour rises from the well and a few cool motes cling to the lilies and to her fingers, soft and calm. Background: a sandy courtyard with a stone well-head dark with damp, the sun just coming over a dune behind it as a thin gold line, pale mist at the stones. Light: gentle dawn light from the upper left, gold at the horizon, with a cool silver rim on her cheek. Expression: content and patient, compassionate, at peace with the small ritual of the morning.

people.imagined: By the frozen lake, a man five times failed, standing with arms crossed and head high; the crooked nose catches the light.
people.subject: The moment: by the frozen lake, a man who has failed the test five times stands with arms crossed and head high; the crooked nose catches the light, and he looks straight at the viewer. Face: a rough, stubborn face of thirty-eight; a nose broken and set crooked, with a faint highlight where the light strikes it; both ears carrying five pale leaf-shaped frostbite scars, one for each failure, red at the edges; hard dark eyes; a clenched jaw; a thin plume of breath. Hair: black, short, rough. Body: stocky, square and planted, feet set in the snow at the lake's edge. Clothing: fresh white silk robes of the outer disciple, simple and graceful, with two crossed collars edged in ice blue and no sash and no collar-band, the cloth of the better kind as if someone had insisted on it; wide sleeves, small silver snowflakes at the cuffs; no pendant at all. Hands and objects: arms crossed over the chest; a plain straight sword in a white scabbard at his belt. Power: none yet, only the breath of cold and a few pale motes of frost that drift past his bare, scarred ears. Background: a white frozen lake and a grey horizon in mist, behind him a reed hut and a line of pale lantern lights where the test is held. Light: hard cold moonlit light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on his crooked nose and jaw. Expression: stubborn and ambitious, brave, a man who has simply refused to be turned back by five failures.

people.imagined: At the vein watch, a blue web of burns climbs her neck; she holds up the right hand with two fingers gone and looks to the sky for thunder.
people.subject: The moment: at the vein watch beneath a thundering sky, a blue web of burns climbing her neck; she holds up the right hand with two fingers gone and looks aside to the sky for thunder, then at the viewer. Face: a calm, lean, weathered face of forty; a faint blue web of lightning-burn scars branching like a tree up the right side of her neck to the jaw, paler than her skin and glowing slightly; steady grey eyes squinting against the flash; lips slightly parted, counting the seconds before thunder. Hair: white and black mixed, cropped short, a silver pin at the crown. Body: tall, lean and still. Clothing: flowing white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, the highest collar closing to the jaw over the scars, a frost-pale gauze over-robe; copper-wire embroidery in fine lines at the wide cuffs beside the silver snowflakes, gleaming faintly; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand held up with only the thumb, forefinger and middle finger, the two missing fingers healed smooth, steady as stone; a thin copper rod beside her. Power: threads of violet-blue lightning crawl over the copper rod and the web on her neck, and cold pale blue motes drift round the maimed hand. Background: a stormy sky, a tall copper rod with a charred tip behind her, a bank of clouds with a violet-blue flicker, mist on the ridge. Light: cold storm light from the upper left with a blue flash at the back and a silver rim along her jaw. Expression: calm, brave and reclusive, a woman at home in the sky that nearly killed her.

people.imagined: In the tea kitchen at dawn, he pours first for the person he fancies; his hands are steam-pink and a stained apron shows under the robe.
people.subject: The moment: in the tea kitchen at dawn, he pours first for the person he fancies; his hands are steam-pink, and a stained apron shows under his robe; he looks up kindly at the viewer. Face: a round, mild face of fifty-five with pink cheeks; small content eyes; a snub nose; a wispy grey moustache; a double chin; a thin sheen of sweat on the forehead. Hair: grey, thinning, in a small knot held by a plain wooden pin. Body: round-shouldered and stout. Clothing: a white silk robe with two crossed collars edged in ice blue and a pale blue gauze over-robe of a steward, wide sleeves tied back with a cord, small silver snowflakes at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; a plain brown tea-stained apron showing under the hem, kept clean and neat. Hands and objects: both hands pink and wrinkled from steam; a dented copper kettle pouring into a pale cup; a tray of three pale porcelain cups before him, one set slightly apart, empty, for someone who has gone three solstices without a hot cup. Power: soft pale blue warmth hangs about his hands and the steam rises in slow curls with faint motes of spirit-light that smell of pine. Background: a tea kitchen with a row of kettles on stone shelves warmed by stored qi, steam and mist drifting. Light: soft golden steamy light from the upper left, a cool silver rim on his shoulder. Expression: humble and contented, an arbitrary kindness in the face, a man happiest when the first cup goes to someone else.

people.imagined: On a windy ridge of the head's own peak, herder's beads at the wrist; she will not let the windburn heal and does not smile.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy ridge of the head's own peak, herder's beads at the wrist; she will not let the windburn heal and does not smile, and looks steadily at the viewer. Face: a strong-boned, weathered face of thirty-three; cheeks raw red with windburn, each patch the shape of a handprint; cool grey eyes narrowed against the gale, tears pulled from the corners; a stern, level mouth; her breath leaves in a short plume and she does not shiver. Hair: black, in one long braid that the wind lifts into a straight line behind her, bound with a white jade ring. Body: tall and wiry, planted square on the ridge with her weight low. Clothing: flowing white silk robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a frost-pale gauze over-robe streaming in the gale; a heavy grey herder's wool cloak, clean and thick, over the shoulders and pinned with a bone toggle; silver snowflakes at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a string of herder's beads, small knuckle-bones strung on black thread, wound at her wrist; both hands resting on the front of the cloak. Power: wind-driven ice crystals spiral around her in a pale blue ring, glittering and holding their shape in the gale. Background: a snowy ridge falling away behind her under a white sky, a single lamp-light twinkling far below at the sect seat, thin drifting mist. Light: cold white moonlike light from the upper left, flat and hard, with a thin silver rim along her braid. Expression: stern, still and closed, a woman who keeps her pain on her face on purpose and will not be pitied.

people.imagined: Last to take off his apron at night, he sits by the furnace at Hàn Giao Chử with the wolves lying round him; the only warm thing they like.
people.subject: The moment: last to take off his apron at night, he sits by the furnace at the cold sect's outer pill-hearth with grey wolves lying round him, the only warm thing they like; he looks up with an open, tired smile. Face: a ruddy, open young face of thirty; a smear of soot on the forehead; warm brown eyes; round cheeks; hands scarred with small burns, forearms freckled with soot. Hair: short black hair, tousled. Body: stocky and sturdy. Clothing: he is a warm-coloured servant of a cold sect and dresses plainly but cleanly: a tunic of soft undyed silk-cotton in warm brown with a crossed collar edged in pale blue, long sleeves rolled to the elbow, a tidy dark apron still on with its strings in a double bow, and a simple blue-grey sash with a small white jade bead; no ornament. Hands and objects: a poker in his right hand; his left hand resting on a wolf's head, one grey wolf leaning its head on his thigh with eyes shut, another dozing with a paw over its nose; a spoon and a jar of dark pill-paste on a ledge by his knee, a kettle singing, a basket of charcoal. Power: faint warm orange embers drift up from the furnace and settle on the wolves' fur like small stars. Background: a furnace glow in a dim hall, white mist at the door, the wolves' pale shapes. Light: red-gold furnace glow from the lower left, cool blue moonlight at the door, a soft rim on his hair. Expression: diligent, humble and trusting, the contentment of a man who is simply glad to be warm among animals.

people.imagined: At her desk, copying the Snow Plum manual in red ink, a red-stained thumbnail showing, a second sheet hidden beneath her.
people.subject: The moment: at her desk, copying the Snow Plum manual in red ink with a stained thumbnail showing, a second sheet hidden beneath her; her eyes are lowered, then lifted a fraction too late to the viewer. Face: a scholarly, delicate oval face of thirty-eight; calm intelligent dark eyes; a small closed smile; slender long fingers with an ink-red thumbnail visible. Hair: black, in a neat low bun with a white jade pin shaped like a plum branch. Body: slim and composed. Clothing: flowing white silk scholar's robes with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a frost-gauze over-robe, wide sleeves with silver plum blossoms and snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs, the right cuff marked with a long red streak where she has wiped the brush; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a slim white sword in its scabbard leaning against the desk; a brush dipped in red ink the colour of dried plum, a stone ink-slab, a neat stack of copied leaves each weighted with a pebble; a second sheet in black ink half under the blotter with one corner visible. Power: petals of pale blue frost-light float down over the page like falling plum blossom as the brush moves. Background: a quiet room with a desk, a lamp of pale paper, drifting mist at the window. Light: soft lamplight from the upper left, cool moonlit rim on her cheek. Expression: patient and humble, with a deceitful composure that is perfectly kind on its surface.

people.imagined: Hauling a pearl diver's net up in a skiff, he coughs like a barking seal and turns his good ear toward the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: hauling a pearl diver's net up in a skiff, he coughs like a barking seal and turns his good ear toward the viewer with a grin. Face: a weathered, generous face of thirty-five; kind squinting eyes; a wide grin showing white, uneven teeth; one ear scarred shut by the deep, a puckered knot of scar, the other whole and turned toward us. Hair: black, wet and tied back with a strip of pale blue silk cord and a silver pin. Body: broad and barrel-chested, chest heaving, a bubble of cough rattling in his throat. Clothing: short white silk robes darkened by wet, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a light frost-gauze outer layer clinging, a pale sealskin vest over it with a thin line of dried salt along the collar; silver wave embroidery at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a straight sword in a white scabbard at his hip; a wet net hauled over the gunwale with a dozen small white pearls, pea-sized, caught in the mesh; at the bottom of the skiff a puddle and two spare dive-weights of black stone. Power: the pearls glow with soft moon-white light and a pale blue ripple of qi runs along the wet net and the water beneath. Background: a flat pewter sea and drifting ice, gulls circling, a boy at the oars behind him looking away, mist on the water. Light: cold clear light from the upper left, flat on the water, with a silver rim on his wet shoulder. Expression: an open, generous, good-humoured grin with crinkled eyes, a man who laughs at his own cough and would give a stranger half his catch.

people.imagined: A well-fed clan son at the outer gate, tucking silk laces into his boots before anyone sees; he smiles at a classmate while memorising her method.
people.subject: The moment: a well-fed clan son at the outer gate, tucking silk laces into his boots before anyone sees; he smiles warmly at a classmate off to one side while memorising her method, then glances at the viewer. Face: a plump, smooth, rosy face of eighteen with a soft double chin; sleek confident dark eyes; a small neat smile; clear skin that has never known a hungry winter; a small mole beside the nose. Hair: black, oiled, parted at the side and tied in a neat knot with a dark cord and a small silver pin. Body: round-bellied, well fed, bent forward at the waist. Clothing: fresh white silk robes of an outer disciple, new and unwrinkled and a little tight across the middle, two crossed collars edged in ice blue, a clan-silk shirt with a pale cuff showing, wide sleeves with silver snowflakes, no sash yet; good boots with silk laces in clan colours, one half-tucked; a small embroidered purse hidden in the sleeve. Hands and objects: a plain white sword in a scabbard at his hip; the fingers push a silk lace into the boot-top; a folded sheet of notes with no writing visible pokes from the other sleeve. Background: a pale lake shore with reed huts and a few thin outer disciples sitting on the ice, soft mist. Light: bright cold morning light from the upper left, a gentle silver rim on his cheek. Expression: ambitious and friendly, a smile for everyone, with something deceitful working quietly behind the eyes.

people.imagined: Homesick, sitting nearest the brazier in two pairs of mittens, wrists thin as reeds.
people.subject: The moment: homesick, sitting nearest the brazier in two pairs of mittens, wrists thin as reeds; she looks up at the viewer with wide wet eyes. Face: a small, pale, thin face of seventeen; huge, trusting dark eyes; a red nose with a drip hanging unnoticed; chapped cheeks; a trembling lower lip held steady; a tiny snowflake of frost on the eyelashes. Hair: light brown, in two short braids tied with pale blue string under a soft white woollen cap pulled low. Body: tiny, hunched and wrapped, knees drawn up to the chest. Clothing: a plain, clean outer-disciple robe of soft white silk, too big at the shoulders, with two crossed collars edged in ice blue and no sash, long sleeves; over it a thick grey scarf wound three times round her neck; padded white leggings; fur-lined boots tied with twine. Hands and objects: two pairs of mittens, the outer grey wool and the inner white, both visible; wrists like reeds poking from the cuffs; her fingers curled toward the brazier's heat. Background: the inside of a wooden hut with rough planks, a glowing iron brazier, a steaming kettle, other disciples bundled in the dark behind her, a few tiny motes of light drifting in the steam. Light: warm brazier glow from below, cold blue moonlight from the door, a soft silver rim on her cap. Expression: wide, wet, hopeful eyes and a lip held tight to keep from trembling, a child being brave about being cold and far from home.

people.imagined: Asleep in the reed hut by the lake after cutting holes, an ice-pick still at his belt, a smell of brine; he opens one eye.
people.subject: The moment: asleep in the reed hut by the lake after cutting fishing holes, an ice-pick still at his belt, a smell of brine; he opens one eye at the viewer. Face: a sunburnt, broad, easy face of twenty; sleepy half-open eyes; a wide gap-toothed smile; a fish-scale stuck to one cheek; chapped lips; a stubble of dark whisker. Hair: black, shaggy and sticking up, with a bit of reed in it. Body: stocky and relaxed, sprawled against a bundle of reeds. Clothing: white silk robes of an outer disciple, sturdy but graceful, two crossed collars edged in ice blue, wide sleeves with small silver snowflakes at the cuffs, the hem stained with brine, no sash; sealskin boots; a thick pale scarf. Hands and objects: a short iron ice-pick tucked into his belt, its wooden handle polished pale by his palm; in one hand a string of small silver fish threaded through the gills; a tin cup of cold fish broth by his knee. Power: none, only the cool breath of the lake and a few drowsy motes of pale light in the doorway. Background: the reed wall of the hut, bright with sun through its gaps, and behind him through the doorway a frozen lake dotted with fishing holes under pale mist, a small boy crouched on one with his heels drumming. Light: pale cold moonlike light from the upper left with warm points of sun through the reeds and a soft silver rim on his cheek. Expression: drowsy, comfortable and unbothered, one eye half open and a slow grin spreading, a man with no wish to be anywhere else.

people.imagined: Just passed the Frost Test last solstice; her eyes are still red-rimmed and she touches her cheek where she wept, as if checking it.
people.subject: The moment: she passed the Frost Test last solstice; her eyes are still red-rimmed and she touches her cheek where she wept, as if checking it, and looks at the viewer. Face: an earnest, soft face of twenty-four; eyes red-rimmed and bright, with a trace of frost at the lashes; a trembling smile; pale cheeks with two faint pink tear-tracks, one still shining on her left cheek; a straight small nose. Hair: black, in a single plait over the shoulder tied with a pale blue ribbon, a few damp strands on her cheek, a small white jade pin at the crown. Body: slim and upright, standing very straight as the newly chosen do. Clothing: new white silk robes of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a frost-gauze over-robe, perfectly folded and not yet creased, with silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering new frost-silk sash with the shop-crease of folded silk and a white jade pendant; new felt boots. Hands and objects: two fingers pressed against her cheek; the other hand holds a small warm stone wrapped in cloth. Power: a faint new thread of pale blue qi glows in her fingertips and a few frost motes catch the dawn around her. Background: a pale frozen lake at dawn in thin mist, a round-faced woman in white in the distance seen from behind and wiping her own eyes, lantern lights along the ice. Light: dawn light from the upper left, pink at the horizon, with a silver rim on her hair. Expression: moved, humble and diligent, tears of relief just dry on a face that has not yet learned to hide them.

people.imagined: A magistrate's son who looks freshly washed, as if his mother still packed his sleeves; he bows to his master.
people.subject: The moment: a magistrate's son who looks freshly washed, as if his mother still packed his sleeves; he bows to his master, who stands slightly out of focus at the edge of the frame, turned away, looking at the sky, and then lifts a calm glance to the viewer. Face: a clean, pleasant, symmetrical face of twenty-five; calm dark eyes; a smooth chin; a faint smile; skin kept soft by good soap; a tiny beauty-mark below one eye. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat topknot with a white-jade pin. Body: slender, tidy and well carried. Clothing: immaculately pressed white silk robes of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a frost-gauze over-robe with neatly folded wide sleeves, silver snowflakes embroidered at the cuffs; a shimmering frost-silk sash tied in a flat symmetrical knot with a white jade pendant; a small sachet of dried herbs at the belt; clean pale shoes without a mark of mud. Hands and objects: both hands tucked into wide sleeves; a plain white sword at his side with a small tassel of green jade on the hilt. Power: a calm, even pale blue shimmer rests along the scabbard and soft frost motes hang still in the air. Background: a white courtyard with a plain pillar and a bare plum branch in mist, the woman master in pale robes. Light: even moonlit light from the upper left, a gentle silver rim on his sleeve. Expression: calm, loyal and patient, with the faint ease of one used to being courted.

people.imagined: Coming off the seal beach with seal oil in the creases of her knuckles, barking a laugh, a pup's soft cuff-fur in her pocket.
people.subject: The moment: coming off the seal beach with seal oil in the creases of her knuckles, barking a laugh, a pup's soft cuff-fur in her pocket; she grins widely at the viewer. Face: a sturdy, freckled, windburnt round face of seventeen; sharp dark eyes; a gap-toothed grin with a missing canine; a flat nose; a fine rime of salt on the brow. Hair: black, in a rough knot with a seal-bone pin. Body: short, sturdy, strong arms; hands red and chapped, nails short and black-rimmed, a thin white scar across the back of the left. Clothing: a white silk robe of an outer disciple, graceful but practical, two crossed collars edged in ice blue, the hem darkened and glossy with old oil, small silver snowflakes at the cuffs, a pale sealskin cape over the shoulders; sealskin boots. Hands and objects: knuckles shiny with seal oil; a small bit of soft white fur showing from a pocket, the cuff of a seal pup, soft as swansdown; a short wooden club at her belt. Power: a faint cool shimmer of spirit-light plays over her oiled knuckles and the spray, the barest hint of cold. Background: a grey beach in mist, seals blurred in a long dark row among grey rocks, surf and a thin line of foam running up the shingle to her bare toes. Light: cold light from the upper left with a silver rim on her windburnt cheek. Expression: brave and impatient, a hard cheerful bark of laughter with nothing soft about it except the pocket.

people.imagined: Asleep in his leather apron at the forge, forearms soot-black to the elbow; woken by a customer.
people.subject: The moment: asleep at the forge, forearms soot-black to the elbow; woken by a customer, he looks up at the viewer with a narrow suspicious stare. Face: a stubborn, narrow face of twenty-one smeared with soot; suspicious pale eyes; thin lips; a small notch in the left ear; a crease pressed into his cheek from dozing against a leather cuff; thick eyebrows meeting in a frown. Hair: black, greasy, in a rough tail held by a plain iron pin. Body: wiry, hunched over the anvil, the soot-line stopping sharply at his elbows where his pale upper arms begin. Clothing: white silk robes of an outer disciple with two crossed collars edged in ice blue, wide sleeves tied back with scorched leather cuff-guards, soot on the silver snowflakes at the cuffs; a plain frost-silk sash with a small coin pouch bulging at it and a faded receipt string hanging from it. Hands and objects: both forearms black to the elbow; a short hammer in the right fist; a half-forged sword blank glowing dull red on the anvil, dropped when he fell asleep, a water trough beside him with a skin of ash; three blades on a rack, none finished. Power: a dull orange-silver glint of metal qi crawls along the red blank and a few sparks of cold white light dance above the trough. Background: a camel-town forge glow, a sand-coloured wall, a clay water jar, three notched sabres on the wall with paid-for tags, pale mist. Light: red forge-glow from below, a cool silver rim on his cheek. Expression: stubborn, greedy and paranoid, a man who counts every coin twice and trusts none of them.

people.imagined: On the lake shore, the third hat lost, a cough hidden behind her hand; she has decided to go to the fishers.
people.subject: The moment: on the lake shore, the third hat lost, a cough hidden behind her hand; she has decided to go to the fishers, and she gives the viewer a small tired smile. Face: a thin, pale, sensible face of twenty-eight; tired, kind eyes bright with a little fever; a pink tip of nose; chapped lips; hair-fine lines at the eyes. Hair: brown, tied in a knot with a strip of faded blue cloth in place of the lost hat. Body: slim, wrapped in a wool shawl, her shoulders drawn in against the cold. Clothing: a simple white silk robe of an outer disciple with two crossed collars edged in ice blue, wide sleeves with silver snowflakes at the cuffs, a grey wool shawl over it, wool leggings, sturdy shoes; snow dusting her shoulders. Hands and objects: one fist raised to her mouth; a small bundle tied with cord at her feet holding a spare tunic and a cooking pot. Power: none; only a thin breath-plume and a few pale motes of frost settling on the shawl. Background: a frozen lake in mist and a line of pale lanterns along the ice where the test is being sat, one thin figure in white walking away from it. Light: flat grey moonlit light from the upper left, with a faint cold silver rim on her cheek. Expression: a small, tired, gentle smile and a slight shrug, as if saying there is no shame in leaving, the look of someone who has weighed it and is at peace.

people.imagined: In the sword hall, cropped head, wrist wrapped in a hand's width of cloth; glaring across the hall at a rival.
people.subject: The moment: in the sword hall, cropped head, wrist wrapped in a hand's width of cloth; he glares across the hall at a rival and then at the viewer. Face: a hard young face of twenty-six, scalp cropped close with a long old scar over one ear; a scarred brow; hot dark eyes; a snarling mouth; a fresh bruise at the jaw; the muscles of the jaw standing out as he grinds his teeth. Hair: cropped to the scalp. Body: compact and tense; sweat darkens the back of his robe. Clothing: white silk robes of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, narrow sleeves cut for the blade, silver snowflakes at the cuffs, a frost-silk sash with a small white jade pendant; white leggings and plain shoes. Hands and objects: his right wrist wrapped in a wide band of soiled grey cloth knotted hard, with a rust-coloured stain at the edge; the hand grips a white-hilted sword. Power: a pale blue edge of frost-light runs down the blade and a faint silver shimmer of heat rises off his shoulders. Background: a sword hall with a polished floor reflecting his figure, a distant white-robed young woman with a sharp-featured face and folded arms, small and out of focus, dissolving into mist. Light: cold moonlit light from the upper left, a silver rim along his scarred scalp. Expression: diligent, loyal and wrathful, a young man who turns every failure into a reason to hit harder.

people.imagined: On the lake ice, writing a bird poem with a quill behind her ear; ink on her chin.
people.subject: The moment: on the lake ice, writing a bird poem with a quill behind her ear and ink on her chin; she looks up dreamily at the viewer. Face: a round, rosy face of nineteen with ink on the chin; dreamy green-brown eyes; a wide smile; a dimple. Hair: brown, loose, with a quill stuck behind the ear and a small silver pin at one side. Body: soft, comfortable and cross-legged. Clothing: soft white silk robes of an outer disciple with two crossed collars edged in ice blue, wide sleeves with silver snowflakes at the cuffs, slips of paper poking out of every fold; a long green silk scarf; fur-lined boots with yellow fur, one lace untied. Hands and objects: a quill; a small book; ink dripped from the quill onto the ice in a small black star; a small stone ink-slab by her knee; a smear of ink on the heel of her hand; the poem on her page a set of small lines with a drawing of an oriole in the corner, no readable words; behind her a tidy herb bed lies under snow and a thin quiet girl with dirt under her nails weeds it with a trowel. Power: a few pale green and blue motes of spirit-light drift up from the wet ink like small birds. Background: a frozen lake in soft mist, birds far off. Light: soft moonlit light from the upper left with a faint silver rim on her cheek. Expression: gregarious, content and dreamy, a girl entirely at home in her own head.
